laura: Quick heads-up  SparkLink (SI) wants an integration demo: LangChain -> LlamaIndex -> our gateway -> Dedicated. Theyd like a 20-min technical deep-dive + a short marketplace bundle preview. Can we scope owners?

ben: I can run the LangChain+LlamaIndex flow and validate sample notebooks. ETA Mon EOD for a smoke summary.

arjun: Ill own the gateway routing rules and model variant fallback checks. Need to know if SparkLink will use streaming. If yes, we should test stream reliability across the Dedicated pool.

nina: Marketing/legal note: co-announcement requires a signed co-marketing addendum. Ill start the doc but legal turnarounds can be 48-72h. ops-bot: please file ticket.

ops-bot: Ticket PARTNER-5012 created: "SparkLink co-marketing + demo infra." Assigned to @nina for follow-up.

ben: Two small tech notes discovered in local runs: 1) LlamaIndex vector store paths may collide across tenants; recommend namespacing keys. 2) LangChain tool-calling with streaming drops final token occasionally in our current runtime config.

arjun: For (1) we can prefix keys by tenant_id. For (2) Ill run a focused stream test against staging and if flaky add a short retry layer in the gateway. Proposed maintenance window: Tue 03:00-04:00 UTC to push gateway fix.

laura: Timeline suggestion: Mon smoke results, Tue gateway push + quick dry run, Wed 09:30 internal dry-run, Wed 13:00 partner demo. If legal not ready, we do demo but keep public materials embargoed.

nina: I'll draft co-brand slide deck and NDA addendum. Posting first pass Tue 10:00 UTC.

arjun: Will post test plan and rollback steps here once maintenance window is scheduled. Simple rollback: revert routing rule and switch traffic to fallback model for 15 mins.

ben: Sharing minimal key namespacing snippet to test: ```python
# tenant-aware vector key
def vector_key(tenant, doc_id):
    return f"{tenant}:lindex:vec:{doc_id}"
```

laura: Thanks team. Keep updates short in this thread; Ill own partner coordination and sign-off times. :white_check_mark:
